title: BTCHN’ Titanium Drop Bars Pre Order Is Live!
content:
BTCHN’ Titanium Drop Bars are back for our second release of 2026. Earlier this summer, BTCHN’ debuted their fully refined fourth-generation design, which really hit the spot for a lot of you. If you missed that run, here’s another shot!

This limited Pre-Order is open from September 9th through September 25th. All orders will ship by December 7th, in time for Christmas.

BTCHN’ 4th Gen Titanium Drop Bar Quick Hits

  • $620
  • Bent, welded, and finished in-house in California
  • Available in Plain Jane or Omakase ($80) anodizing finish
  • 31.8mm Clamp Diameter
  • 73mm Reach
  • 107mm Drop
  • Custom Width: 34cm – 50cm (Hood to hood width)
  • Custom Flare: 8°, 15°, or 25°
  • Weight: (40cm 370g) (42cm 377g) (44cm 384g) (46cm 391g) (48cm 398g) (50cm 405g)
  • 30 day Ride It Guarantee, no questions asked

Using a 3D printed corner section, BTCHN’ shaped this bar around actual riding needs: comfort, control, aerodynamics, and fit. The long hood transition creates a stable platform for staying low and fast, while the tight-radius corners maximize usable width on the tops for better leverage and control.

For Gen 4, BTCHN’ refined the fit and feel of the printed corners, made them easier to wrap with bar tape, redesigned the butted center section for improved aerodynamics, and reduced the circumference of the tops for better grip and comfort across a wider range of hand sizes and tape thicknesses.

The short reach and shallow drop keep your fit compact, while the smaller diameter titanium drops smooth washboard chatter and trail buzz when speeds pick up.

Preorder your Ti Drop Bars today!
